meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会安装 OneCLI 网关,把 .env 里的密钥搬进安全仓库,再重新构建并重启 NanoClaw 服务,最后检查日志确认生效。它还会先检查现有配置,必要时问你选择。
howto.when: 当你运行 /init-onecli,或 /update-nanoclaw 更新带来了 OneCLI 的破坏性变更,或首次设置 OneCLI 时触发。

say.text: 初始化 OneCLI,把 .env 里的密钥迁过去
say.note: Claude 会安装网关并迁移凭证。

say.text: 检查 OneCLI 配好没有,没配就安装
say.note: 先做预检,再决定后续步骤。
从旧方式迁移到保险库。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude installs the OneCLI gateway, migrates existing .env credentials into the Agent Vault, rebuilds and restarts the service, then verifies the setup. It also checks existing configuration and prompts the user when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /init-onecli, after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or during first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI and migrate my .env credentials into the vault.
Check if OneCLI is configured; install it if not.
Switch me to the OneCLI Agent Vault.
say_en.note: Moves relevant credentials to the vault.
